lines.trans: There are days when everything goes wrong.

words.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

lines.trans: In the kitchen today there was real rush.
The chef shouted, and the orders did not end.
But such difficult days always end.
To someone this day brought something new.
For someone everything stays the same.

words.gloss: as before, in the old way

lines.trans: Hi, Nastya, glad to see you.
I hope your shift went well.

words.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

lines.trans: Seven thousand rubles on Spartak!
My favorite team will definitely win!
Someone is sincerely happy with this day.
And I am happy that it ended.
Tomorrow in the kitchen new work will begin.

words.gloss: to begin, to start, to break out

lines.trans: And today it is time to rest a little.

words.gloss: to have a rest; to relax

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.en: to end, to finish, to come to an end

meanings.note: the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

meanings.en: rush, chaos, time crunch (in kitchen or work)

examples.trans: A rush began in the kitchen.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я вам искренне сочувствую.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I sincerely sympathize with you.
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.
Finally someone is for the people!
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

начаться.gloss: to begin, to start, to break out

meanings.en: to begin, to start, to break out (intransitive)

examples.trans: The film started at seven sharp.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

отдохнуть.gloss: to have a rest; to relax

по-старому.gloss: as before, in the old way

meanings.en: as before, in the old way, as usual
to defeat, to beat, to win
meanings.note: 1st person singular is not used in standard Russian
+ infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.
What did you bring into the flat?

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.note: 'Пройдёмте' = let's go, an official's polite order
short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.
I haven't got a single rouble.

meanings.note: morning or afternoon shift at school or work

examples.trans: We're on the afternoon shift today.
The film has a happy ending.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест
я что-то вижу = I see something
colloquial, used as an adverb: что-то я не вижу = somehow I don't see it

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
